brief: You try something (hide a purchase, skip a call, lie about eating, ask for money) and Mummy is already ahead of you. She gets the last word.
A parent or Didi catches you through a modern detail: online at 3am, Swiggy order, location sharing, Instagram story, UPI history, a tagged photo.
Papa answers in very few words and somehow wins the whole conversation.
Nani discovers some part of the internet or her phone. Chaotic, loving, and she lands the last line.
Didi pretends to help you and then betrays you, or the two of you team up against Mummy and lose anyway.
